# `scikitplot.seaborn`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

Seaborn-style scikit-plots plotting.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
```

The release on PyPI can be older than the version this skill was read from, and
can lack `scikitplot.seaborn`. If `import scikitplot.seaborn` fails after
installing it, the installed release predates the module: the [release history
on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/scikit-plots/#history) lists each release,
and [pip's user guide](https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/user_guide/) explains
upgrading.

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it:

```sh
python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"
python -c "import scikitplot.seaborn as m, inspect; print(inspect.signature(m.<name>)); help(m.<name>)"
```

## Public API

Declared in `scikitplot.seaborn.__all__`, in that order.

| Name | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `aucplot` | function | Plot PR or ROC curves with a seaborn-like API. |
| `decileplot` | function | Given binary labels y_true (0/1) and probabilities y_score 1d array, compute/plot a decile table. |
| `evalplot` | function | Visualization of the Confusion Matrix alongside a text report showing key classification metrics. |
| `modelplot` | function | Model Instance and/or Attributes Visualization. |
| `print_labels` | function | Pretty-print the legend of decile table column names. |

All names with signatures: [references/API.md](references/API.md).

## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.seaborn.print_labels`)

```pycon
>>> import scikitplot.seaborn as sp
>>> sp.print_labels()
```
